items.title: Analyze whether scope_check_save should stay PLAN-only or split into planning-scope vs later-phase acknowledgment
items.context: command-policy.ts:111 sets scope_check_save allowedPhases:['PLAN']; config.ts:153 lists it only under PLAN phase tools. When a story rolls back TEST→DEV and adds checklist scope, scope-plan reviewer cannot write a signed scope-check.json (verbal pass only). Decide: keep PLAN-only, or split into a PLAN planning-scope write command + a later-phase evidence/scope acknowledgment command. This is analysis-only backlog — does not block main and does not affect the B-c9f5 dirty gate closure.
items.userSees: docs/requirements/decisions/story-lifecycle.md contains a scope evidence hygiene section stating scope_check_save stays PLAN-only and scope_contract_acknowledge is the DEV/REVIEW acknowledgement path.

happy.desc: story-lifecycle documents that scope_check_save remains PLAN-only signed scope review evidence.

edge.desc: docs name scope_contract_acknowledge as the DEV/REVIEW later-phase scope change acknowledgement path.

adversarial.desc: docs explicitly avoid treating later-phase acknowledgement as a replacement for PLAN scope reviewer pass.
